title: Unable to use full area of ScrollBar with custom StyleBox type that has a min size
body: ### Tested versions Reproducable: - v4.5.1.stable.mono.official [f62fdbde1] - v4.7.dev.mono.custom_build [bf95b6258] ### System information Godot v4.5.1.stable.mono - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Mobile) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.5599) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-10750H CPU @ 2.60GHz (12 threads) - 15.76 GiB memory ### Issue description When writing custom `StyleBox` types, scrollbars use the background's min size to determine the grabber's size instead of the content margins. This reduces control over grabber positioning/sizing since is always at least background min size smaller than the background and cannot cover the entire background when content margins are set to 0. A more concrete thing this issue prevents is making a modified version of `StyleBoxTexture` since a user either gets to define the min size based on texture margins or allow the grabber to cover the background, but not both. In the picture, the scrollbar is set to max value, but can only get to 100 from the bottom of the background since the min height is 100. ### Steps to reproduce - Make a custom `StyleBox` type - Have it override `_get_minimum_size()` to be something non-zero - Notice when the custom type is used in a `ScrollBar`'s `scroll` theme property, the grabber is more contrained than when using `StyleBoxTexture` with the same min size ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [scrollbar with custom stylebox.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25427722/scrollbar.with.custom.stylebox.zip) -Scroll the scrollbar or change the value property in editor and notice how the grabber cannot reach the bottom content margin as long as the custom style box's minimum size is larger.
